text:
frank: Quick thread  proposing a 'soft-cutover runway' for new catalog entries: combines short pin, tenant grace quotas, and a pin-exception ledger. want to nail launch gates today.

anya: Nice. What's the core difference vs our usual pin TTL?

frank: Soft-cutover is lower-friction: default 10-day pin, can extend per-tenant via grace quota, and we log every exception in a ledger for audit + billing changes.

ricardo: Need clear metric hooks. I suggest two mandatory slices: observed latency P95 delta vs baseline, and a downstream quality slice (top-10 intents). Also require a real-traffic smoke (sampled traffic > 500 tokens in 24h).

sophie: Ops: we must prevent mixed-hardware exposures. soft-cutover cohorts get a hw_affinity label and denied routing if mismatch. Also require a canary route id.

catalog-bot: deploy-guard: hw_affinity, eval_artifact_url, sample_traffic_metric present  blocking if missing.

frank: Draft gates below (YAML-ish):
```
soft_cutover_runway_v1:
  pin_ttl: 10d
  per_tenant_grace: 3 x 7d extends max
  routing_sample_threshold: 500 tokens / 24h
  p95_latency_delta_allowance: <=3%
  quality_top10_intent_drop: <=1.5% absolute
  hw_affinity: required
  pin_exception_ledger: append-only record with requestor, reason, expiry
  incentive_credit: optional one-off 1-week credit gated on routing threshold
  rollback_fastpath: immediate auto-fallback to prior pinned model + customer webhook
```

anya: Love the ledger idea for audits. We should surface ledger entries in the catalog UI and exportable CSV.

ricardo: For the quality_top10_intent metric we need a owner and a stable eval harness. product or applied-ml?

frank: Product maintains the canonical top10 intent slice. Applied-ML will own the harness integration.

catalog-bot: note: pin_exception_ledger schema required fields: requestor, tenant_id, reason, start_ts, expiry_ts.

sophie: One more ops ask: pin_ttl needs a soft-grace window for infra cutover (48h) to avoid simultaneous auto-unpins during peak. Maybe stagger unpins by tenant shard.

anya: Also recommend a clear deprecation calendar requirement: if model will be deprecated, a deprecation_notice field with harvest window and migration incentives must be attached at onboarding.

frank: Good call. Add deprecation_notice requirement.

ricardo: Thoughts on incentives? 1-week credit seems fine but gate on >2k tokens routed within the first week to qualify. prevents abuse.

frank: Agree. Update gating to 2k for credit.

catalog-bot: checklist for soft-cutover canary: [eval_artifact_url, hw_affinity, sample_traffic_metric, deprecation_notice, pin_exception_ledger_enabled] all must be present.

sophie: Pilot plan: pick 4 internal-only models (no external tenants) next sprint, test staggering unpins and ledger, confirm UI surfaces.

frank: Action items:
- anya: add ledger view wireframe + CSV export spec (EOD Thu)
- ricardo: finalize metric definitions + eval harness ticket (48h)
- sophie: infra changes for hw_affinity enforcement + staggered unpin logic (PR by next Tue)
- applied-ml: hook in harness and run pilot (coordinate with sophie)

anya: tagging owners, will sync with design.

frank: if no objections, i'll merge this into the onboarding checklist doc and open a pilot epic. :rocket:
